item.title: Daily Briefing — 2026-08-27
item.description: BJJ: ADCC 2026 Krakow 16-Day Countdown — Superfight Set, Historic Open Brackets. | Soccer: Atletico 2-2 Villarreal, Le Normand Red Card; Alvarez Transfer Endgame in 5 Days. | Finance: SPOT +5.5% on Buyback Expansion; AAPL +1.1% on M6 Mac Mini; NJ Rates Fall to 6.74%. | NJ Local: Saint Sebastian Feast Montclair through Aug 29; NJ Airshow Cape May Aug 28-31.
item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • ADCC 2026 Krakow 16-Day Final Countdown: Duarte vs. Simoes Superfight Confirmed, Men’s Brackets Historically Wide Open
    ADCC 2026 is 16 days from its September 12-13 Tauron Arena, Krakow opening, with the Kaynan Duarte vs. Yuri Simões superfight now officially on the card — the only confirmed superfight — while all eight bracket draws are set but considered the most open in championship history, with multiple weight classes having no defending champion or consensus frontrunner.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe / ADCC News
  • Helena Crevar’s 21-Submission Win Streak Makes Her ADCC 2026’s Must-Watch Athlete at Women’s -60kg
    Helena Crevar has won 21 consecutive matches by submission — a streak that spans her entire ADCC 2026 qualifying campaign and makes her the standout favorite and must-watch athlete in the women’s -60kg bracket at September 12-13’s Krakow World Championship, where she will attempt to become the first competitor in ADCC history to win every match by submission in a full 8-woman bracket.
    Source: Yardbarker / ADCC News
  • ADCC 2026 Streams Live on Digitsu and FloGrappling Sept 12-13 — Full Two-Day Broadcast From Krakow
    ADCC 2026’s complete two-day September 12-13 broadcast from Tauron Arena Krakow will stream live on both Digitsu (pay-per-view) and FloGrappling (subscription), with the women’s and men’s brackets running concurrently across both days — the largest-ever ADCC broadcast with all 128 competitors competing live.
    Source: Digitsu

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Atletico 2-2 Villarreal at Metropolitano — VAR Red Card for Le Normand in 76th Minute Proves Costly
    Atletico Madrid drew 2-2 at home to Villarreal in La Liga Matchday 2 after the Metropolitano’s mood turned on a VAR-reviewed red card for defender Robin Le Normand in the 76th minute — a decision that overturned the original yellow — forcing Simeone’s 10-man side to surrender a 2-1 lead and settle for a point that could prove costly in a tight title race.
    Source: beIN Sports / Into the Calderon
  • Alvarez Transfer Endgame: Arsenal Now Front-Runner With 5 Days to September 1 Deadline — Player Softening on Move
    Arsenal have re-emerged as front-runners in the Julián Álvarez saga with just 5 days until the September 1 transfer deadline, after Atletico Madrid set a final sell-by date for the Argentine; sources indicate Álvarez has softened on his resistance to Arsenal, and the Gunners have put forward a package exceeding €100M to end the impasse.
    Source: Sky Sports / Yahoo Sports
  • Atletico Travel to Sevilla for MD3 This Saturday — Le Normand Suspended, September 1 Transfer Deadline as Backdrop
    With Robin Le Normand serving a one-game suspension following his red card in the Villarreal draw, Atletico travel to Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán to face Sevilla on Saturday (La Liga Matchday 3) — a tricky early-season road test as the September 1 transfer window deadline adds further off-pitch tension around the Álvarez situation.
    Source: La Liga

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Spotify Expands Share Buyback Program to $2.2B Total — SPOT Jumps 5.5%, Now Trading Near $550
    Spotify announced an expansion of its share repurchase authorization to a total of $2.2 billion, driving SPOT shares up 5.5% to approximately $550 — the largest single-day gain since Q1 earnings — as the company signals confidence in its free cash flow trajectory following its record-breaking Q2 report ($610M operating income).
    Source: Digital Music News / Music Business Worldwide
  • Apple M6 Mac Mini Launched at $899 (+12.5% Price Hike); iPhone Event September 9 Under New CEO Ternus — AAPL +1.1%
    Apple launched the M6 Mac Mini starting at $899 — a 12.5% price increase over the M4 model — while confirming a September 9 iPhone event under new CEO John Ternus, with AAPL shares rising 1.1% to approximately $349; the price hike is being closely watched as a signal of Apple’s pricing power under new leadership.
    Source: MacDailyNews / ts2.tech
  • NJ 30-Year Mortgage Rate Falls to 6.74% — Sub-7% for First Time Since Spring as Bond Yields Retreat
    New Jersey’s 30-year fixed mortgage rate fell to 6.74% this week — the first sub-7% reading since spring — as 10-year Treasury yields retreated following cooler-than-expected economic data; homeowners and buyers in NJ are watching closely for a sustained drop toward 6.5% that could unlock a wave of refinancing activity.
    Source: NerdWallet

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • Saint Sebastian Feast & Carnival Through Saturday Aug 29 at Kaveny Field, Montclair — Italian Food, Rides, Live Music Nightly
    The annual Saint Sebastian Feast and Carnival runs through Saturday August 29 at Kaveny Field (near Immaculate Conception High School) in Montclair — nightly rides, Italian food vendors, live music, and carnival games from 6pm each evening, a beloved Montclair family tradition and one of the last big outdoor events before Labor Day weekend.
    Source: Montclair Girl / NJ Family
  • Montclair Property Tax Bills Delayed: Triple-Whammy Hike Arrives Before Month’s End — ~$1,565 in Extra Annual Charges
    Montclair property tax bills for Q3 have been delayed, but residents should expect delivery before the end of August; the bills reflect a “triple-whammy” increase from the school budget referendum, township operating increases, and Essex County levy changes, adding an estimated $1,565 in extra annual charges for the average assessed home — a significant hit for NJ homeowners already stretched by the cost of living.
    Source: Montclair Local / Jersey Bee
  • NJ Airshow at Cape May Airport Aug 28-31 — Historic Aircraft, Flyovers, and Food Trucks for Labor Day Weekend
    The New Jersey Airshow returns to Cape May Airport August 28-31 for the Labor Day weekend, featuring historic military aircraft, precision aerial demonstrations, and food vendors — a roughly 2-hour drive from Montclair and a spectacular outdoor outing for families and aviation enthusiasts.
    Source: NJ Family

item.title: Daily Briefing — 2026-08-23
item.description: BJJ: Tackett's 4th UFC BJJ Title Defense, Fornarino-Moura Flyweight GP Final Set at UFC BJJ 10. | Soccer: Atletico Open La Liga Defense With 2-0 Win — Lee Kang-In Scores Dream Debut Goal vs. Malaga. | Finance: Bond Selloff Hammers Markets This Week; Recovery Begins as 10-Year Yield Peaks at 4.73%. | NJ Local: Montclair Weekend (Aug 22-23): Flea at Lackawanna, Turtle Back Zoo Night Moves, Jamaica Fest at Brewery.
item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • Tackett's 4th UFC BJJ Title Defense, Fornarino-Moura Flyweight GP Final Set at UFC BJJ 10
    Andrew Tackett submitted Jonnatas Gracie with a face crank at 1:44 of round one on August 20, making his fourth welterweight title defense before calling out UFC star Paddy Pimblett; Brianna Ste-Marie also won gold over Rebeca Lima by arm-triangle, and Adele Fornarino and Cassia Moura advanced to the inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix final.
    Source: UFC / Combat Press
  • ADCC 2026 Roster Shakeups With 20 Days to Go: Pessanha Replaces Guedes, Rodriguez and Cisneros Also Out
    Gabi Pessanha — winner of every major IBJJF gi title — enters the ADCC 2026 women's bracket as a replacement for Rafaela Guedes; Jacob Rodriguez withdrew to compete at UFC BJJ 11 and Josh Cisneros is also out, leaving two weight divisions (66kg, 88kg) with open slots as the September 12-13 Krakow World Championship approaches.
    Source: ADCC News
  • ADCC Youth World Championship Aug 9: Art of JiuJitsu Tops Team Standings With 10 Golds in Austin
    Art of JiuJitsu dominated the second-ever ADCC Youth World Championship on August 9 in Austin, Texas, collecting 10 gold and 16 total medals to lead team standings ahead of Alpha Miami Grappling — showcasing the next generation of elite grapplers in the lead-up to the September 12-13 senior Worlds in Krakow.
    Source: Jits Magazine

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Atletico Open La Liga Defense With 2-0 Win — Lee Kang-In Scores Dream Debut Goal vs. Malaga
    Lee Kang-In, signed from PSG for £34.3M, came off the bench in the 57th minute and curled a stunning debut strike inside the far post in the 70th minute, with Álex Baena adding a free-kick to seal a 2-0 win over Malaga on August 19 — a confident opening statement for Simeone's La Liga title defense despite a slow first half.
    Source: ESPN / Into the Calderon
  • Atletico Host Villarreal Today in La Liga Matchday 2 — 17:00 CEST at the Metropolitano
    Atletico Madrid look to go 2-for-2 in La Liga as they host Villarreal at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano today (17:00 CEST, matchday 2); Villarreal drew 2-2 with promoted Racing Santander in their opener, and Simeone will be counting on Kang-in and Baena to continue their early-season form at home.
    Source: FotMob / La Liga
  • Alvarez Transfer Saga: Clubs Agree Arsenal Deal, But Player Turns It Down — September 1 Deadline Looms
    Atletico Madrid and Arsenal reportedly reached an agreement to sell Julian Alvarez on August 22, but the Argentine has turned down the Premier League move, still preferring Barcelona despite Atletico's firm refusal to sell there — with the September 1 transfer deadline now just 9 days away, the saga enters a critical final chapter.
    Source: GoalDailyArsenal / Football365

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Bond Selloff Hammers Markets This Week; Recovery Begins as 10-Year Yield Peaks at 4.73%
    Oil-price inflation fears drove Treasury yields sharply higher this week — 10-year to 4.734%, 30-year to 5.273% — triggering a broad equity selloff that pressured VTI; markets started recovering on August 22 (Dow +0.98%, S&P 500 +0.43%) as yields pulled back slightly, though NJ 30-year fixed mortgage rates remain elevated well above 7%.
    Source: CNBC / TheStreet
  • Spotify (SPOT) Surges 6% Against Tech Selloff, Crosses 200-Day Moving Average — Up 12.5% Past Month
    Spotify (SPOT) bucked the market downturn with a 6% gain on August 18, adding nearly $7 billion in market cap; the stock has risen 12.5% over the past month and has crossed above its 200-day moving average — a technical signal that historically precedes further gains 80% of the time — with SPOT now trading around $533-$540.
    Source: The Crypto Basic / Schaeffer's Investment Research
  • Apple CEO Transition to Ternus September 1 — BofA Keeps $380 Buy Target, Bolder AI Strategy Expected
    Apple (AAPL, ~$317) hands the CEO role from Tim Cook to hardware chief John Ternus on September 1; Bank of America maintains its Buy rating with a $380 price target and expects Ternus to pursue larger R&D and AI spending with potential entry into eyewear and robotics — though Apple also laid off 60 employees from its VR team this week.
    Source: TipRanks / Blockonomi

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • Montclair Weekend (Aug 22-23): Flea at Lackawanna, Turtle Back Zoo Night Moves, Jamaica Fest at Brewery
    Three great options this weekend: the Montclair Flea returns to Lackawanna Station (Sat 11am-5pm, vintage finds and food); Turtle Back Zoo's Night Moves after-hours nocturnal animal tour starts at 7:15pm Saturday; and the 8th Annual Jamaica Independence Day Celebration at Montclair Brewery runs Saturday 4-10pm with Caribbean music, food, and craft drinks.
    Source: Montclair Local / Montclair Girl
  • The Wiggles at Wellmont Theater Today — Three Shows at 11am, 2pm & 5pm
    The Wiggles bring their Tree of Wisdom Spectacular to Montclair's Wellmont Theater today (Sunday, August 23) with three shows at 11am, 2pm, and 5pm — a high-energy, all-ages family performance featuring the beloved Australian kids' group with dancing and surprises; tickets at wellmont.com.
    Source: Montclair Girl
  • Free Zootopia 2 Outdoor Movie at Brookdale Park Next Saturday — Aug 29, Doors 7pm, Rain Date Aug 30
    Montclair Film's free Movie Nights Under the Stars series screens Zootopia 2 at Essex County Brookdale Park next Saturday, August 29 (doors 7pm, screening at sundown) — no tickets needed, all ages welcome, and registration at montclairfilm.org is recommended for weather updates; rain date is Sunday August 30.
    Source: Montclair Film

item.title: Daily Briefing — 2026-08-04
item.description: BJJ: ADCC 2026: Three Defending Champions Out 39 Days Before Krakow — Reis, Galvao, Bodoni Won't Defend Their Titles. | Soccer: Atletico Issues Alvarez 'Triple Ultimatum': Choose Arsenal, PSG, or Stay — Barcelona Locked Out, Decide by August 14-15. | Finance: Spotify Beats Q2 2026 Pre-Market: Revenue and Gross Margin Top Expectations — SPOT Stock Jumps at Open. | NJ Local: Rebirth Brass Band Tonight at Montclair Jazz Soundcheck — Free New Orleans Show at Wellmont Arts Plaza, 6pm.
item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • ADCC 2026: Three Defending Champions Out 39 Days Before Krakow — Reis, Galvao, Bodoni Won't Defend Their Titles
    Defending champions at 66kg (Diogo Reis), 77kg (Mica Galvao, out amid family legal fallout) and 88kg (Giancarlo Bodoni, recovering from dual knee and elbow surgeries) have all been removed from the ADCC 2026 bracket — combined with no UFC BJJ champions choosing to compete at the September 12-13 Krakow event, star power concerns deepen for a 128-athlete field that still carries a $362,000 prize pool with 39 days remaining.
    Source: MMA Mania / Yahoo Sports
  • UFC BJJ 10 Enters 16-Day Countdown: Three Title Fights and Women's Grand Prix as Last No-Gi Card Before ADCC
    UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex, free on YouTube) is 16 days away with Andrew Tackett defending the Welterweight belt against Jonnatas Gracie, Ethan Crelinsten vs. Renato Canuto for the Lightweight title, and Brianna Ste-Marie vs. Women's Featherweight champion Rebeca Lima — plus the inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix semis featuring Adele Fornarino; with ADCC Krakow just 23 days after that, this card is submission grappling's final competitive showcase before the world championships.
    Source: UFC / Tapology
  • Full ADCC 2026 Bracket Now Confirmed at 128 Grapplers With Replacement Invites Locked In
    ADCC has confirmed all 128 competitors for September 12-13 in Krakow following four discretionary replacement invites for withdrawn athletes — Kaynan Duarte and Yuri Simoes remain headliners in the absolute division, and Helena Crevar's 21-consecutive-submission winning streak makes her the women's -60kg favorite as the most dominant active athlete heading into the event.
    Source: Yardbarker / ADCC News

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Atletico Issues Alvarez 'Triple Ultimatum': Choose Arsenal, PSG, or Stay — Barcelona Locked Out, Decide by August 14-15
    Atletico Madrid have formally told Julian Alvarez to choose between Arsenal (reportedly making 'groundbreaking progress'), PSG, or remaining in Madrid before August 14-15 — Barcelona is definitively excluded from negotiations despite being the player's stated preference, in a decisive push by Atletico to resolve the summer's longest transfer saga before their August 16 La Liga opener at Espanyol.
    Source: TeamTalk / Sports Mole
  • Arsenal Emerge as Frontrunners for Alvarez as PSG Cools — €125M+ Fee, 10-Day Window to Close
    With PSG having cooled interest following Alvarez's public preference for Barcelona, Arsenal have overtaken them in Atletico's priorities for the Argentine striker at a reported €125M+ fee; the 10-day window before August 14-15 is now critical — Atletico will retain Sorloth as attacking insurance if the deal falls through, meaning Simeone's striker situation could be resolved or confirmed-unresolved before the La Liga opener.
    Source: Yahoo Sports UK / TransferFeed
  • Seoul Man City Showdown in 5 Days: Simeone's Final Pre-Season Look Before La Liga, Striker Vacancy Still Open
    Atletico Madrid face Manchester City at Seoul's World Cup Stadium on August 9 — now 5 days away — in Simeone's last pre-season opportunity to test summer signings Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in before the August 16 La Liga opener, but the match arrives with Alvarez still in the squad and the transfer decision pending by August 14-15, leaving Simeone unable to finalize his attacking shape.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Spotify Beats Q2 2026 Pre-Market: Revenue and Gross Margin Top Expectations — SPOT Stock Jumps at Open
    Spotify (SPOT) reported Q2 2026 results pre-market this morning, beating on both revenue and gross margin (guided at €4.8B / 33.1% respectively) — sending shares jumping before the open and vindicating the buy-the-dip case after last Friday's 3.46% sympathy sell-off; the beat also confirms continued MAU growth (guided 778M) and premium subscriber momentum (299M), giving investors confidence heading into the AMD earnings print tonight.
    Source: Investing.com / MarketBeat
  • AMD Reports After Bell Tonight: $11.2B Revenue (+46% YoY) and $1.67 EPS Expected as AI Chip Demand Drives Semiconductor Surge
    Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) reports Q2 2026 after tonight's market close with consensus targeting $11.2B revenue (up 46% year-over-year) and non-GAAP EPS of $1.67 — AMD shares have rebounded sharply toward $500 following Palantir's Monday beat ($0.41 EPS vs. $0.33 estimate) and sustained AI infrastructure spending signals from Microsoft Azure; the AMD print is the week's most important AI hardware read for VTI holders with large semiconductor exposure.
    Source: FX Leaders / TradingKey
  • NFP Jobs Report Friday: 83K Forecast, 4.3% Unemployment — Pivotal for NJ Mortgage Rates and September Fed Decision
    Friday's July nonfarm payrolls report (8:30am ET, Friday August 7) is the week's defining macro event: economists forecast 83,000 new jobs and a 4.3% unemployment rate, a reading that will determine whether the Fed can cut at its September meeting — a strong print risks pushing NJ's 30-year fixed mortgage rate (currently ~7.02%) higher before fall home-buying season while weak data accelerates rate-cut expectations.
    Source: TradingKey / ts2.tech

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • Rebirth Brass Band Tonight at Montclair Jazz Soundcheck — Free New Orleans Show at Wellmont Arts Plaza, 6pm
    New Orleans legends Rebirth Brass Band perform tonight (August 4, 6pm) at Wellmont Arts Plaza as part of the Montclair Jazz Festival's free Soundcheck Series, bringing jazz, funk, hip-hop, and second-line brass energy downtown — the show is free and all-ages, a perfect post-National Night Out option just blocks from Lackawanna Station; the Montclair Jazz Festival proper follows on August 15.
    Source: Montclair Jazz Festival / Montclair Local
  • Barnes & Noble Opens 25,000 sq ft Livingston Store Tomorrow — Harlan Coben Ribbon Cutting at 9am Wednesday
    A brand-new 25,000-square-foot Barnes & Noble opens Wednesday August 5 at 530 W Mt Pleasant Ave, Livingston (about 15 minutes from Montclair) with a 9am grand opening featuring local thriller author Harlan Coben signing copies of his latest book 'I Will Find You' — the store carries books, toys, games, gifts, and a Barnes & Noble Café, making it a great mid-week outing for readers of all ages.
    Source: NJ1015 / NJ Family
  • Barknic at Lackawanna Station This Saturday Aug 8 — Dog-Friendly Fundraiser for Wise Animal Rescue, Noon to 5pm
    Barknic returns to 1 Lackawanna Plaza, Montclair this Saturday August 8 from 12pm-5pm with adoptable animals, local vendors, giveaways, and family activities all benefiting Wise Animal Rescue — dogs are welcome and the event is free to browse, making it a fun Saturday afternoon option for families with pets; it follows Friday's First Friday at Lackawanna Station (5-9pm, Aug 7).
    Source: Montclair Girl / The Jersey Sound

item.title: Daily Briefing — 2026-08-03
item.description: BJJ: ADCC 2026 Makes History as First Polish World Championship — Krakow's Tauron Arena Set for Europe's Biggest Grappling Event. | Soccer: Alvarez Transfer Limbo Enters New Week: No PSG Deal Signed as La Liga Countdown Hits 13 Days. | Finance: Markets Open Week Bullish: S&P 500 Futures Green on Iran De-Escalation, Palantir Earnings Tonight After Bell. | NJ Local: National Night Out Montclair Tomorrow: Aug 4, 5-8pm at Lackawanna Station — Police, Fire, Family Fun, Free Admission.
item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • ADCC 2026 Makes History as First Polish World Championship — Krakow's Tauron Arena Set for Europe's Biggest Grappling Event
    ADCC 2026 marks the first time the World Submission Grappling Championship has come to Poland, with Tauron Arena Krakow preparing nearly 12,000 seats for a 128-athlete field that includes homegrown Polish qualifiers and European names from Germany, Britain, Spain, and Sweden — the Polish staging is seen as a key moment in the sport's push to build a global fanbase beyond its North American and Brazilian roots.
    Source: Kakutogi
  • ADCC Bracket Finalized After Five Departures: Pearman at 77kg, Hamilton at -55kg as Governance Questions Linger
    ADCC 2026's 128-athlete roster is now locked following five pre-event departures: Taylor Pearman slots into the 77kg bracket in place of removed Izaak Michell (facing an active arrest warrant), while Valerie Wong Hamilton steps into the -55kg spot vacated by Adele Fornarino, who chose the UFC BJJ 10 Women's Flyweight Grand Prix over Krakow — the late removals have raised questions about ADCC's vetting process with 40 days to go.
    Source: MMA Mania / Yahoo Sports
  • Crelinsten vs. Canuto Lightweight Title Fight the Hidden Gem of UFC BJJ 10 — 17 Days to August 20 Card
    With UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, free on YouTube) 17 days away, Ethan Crelinsten vs. Renato Canuto for the lightweight title stands out as the card's most technically compelling matchup — Canadian submission specialist Crelinsten faces the hard-charging Canuto, who stepped up as a late replacement at UFC BJJ 2 and now gets the full-camp treatment for this title shot.
    Source: Tapology / UFC

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Alvarez Transfer Limbo Enters New Week: No PSG Deal Signed as La Liga Countdown Hits 13 Days
    Monday August 3 opens with no official announcement on Julian Alvarez's departure from Atletico Madrid — despite reported PSG framework agreement and personal terms in place — as the August 16 La Liga opener at Espanyol looms as the de facto hard deadline; Simeone has only one pre-season game left (vs. Man City in Seoul, August 9) to assess his squad amid the striker uncertainty.
    Source: TransferFeed / Yahoo Sports
  • Atletico's Final Pre-Season Test: Seoul vs. Man City August 9 — Six Days to Simeone's Last Look Before La Liga
    Atletico Madrid's second and final pre-season fixture comes in six days when they face Manchester City at Seoul's World Cup Stadium on August 9, giving Simeone his last opportunity to assess summer signings Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in together before La Liga — with the Alvarez and Sorloth situations both unresolved, the squad's attacking shape remains an open question heading into the Seoul test.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official
  • La Liga 2026-27 Opens August 16-17: Atletico at Espanyol, Real Madrid and Barcelona Begin Three-Way Title Chase
    La Liga's new season kicks off August 16-17 with defending champion Atletico Madrid opening away at Espanyol's RCDE Stadium amid striker-vacancy concerns, while Real Madrid (returning Champions League holders) and a reshaping Barcelona also launch campaigns that analysts forecast as a three-team title race — the closest La Liga opening in years with all three clubs undergoing significant summer changes.
    Source: La Liga Official

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Markets Open Week Bullish: S&P 500 Futures Green on Iran De-Escalation, Palantir Earnings Tonight After Bell
    U.S. equity markets enter the week of August 3 with a bullish setup — S&P 500 futures point green (86% probability of an up day) on continued geopolitical relief; 85% of S&P 500 reporters have beaten estimates so far this season; Palantir (PLTR) reports Q2 after tonight's close ($1.81B revenue consensus, $0.34 EPS) as the week's first major tech catalyst, with AMD also reporting later this week.
    Source: CNBC / TradingKey
  • SPOT Earnings Tomorrow Pre-Market: $3.29 EPS Consensus (+783% YoY), Options Price 8.6% Swing for Spotify
    Spotify (SPOT) reports Q2 2026 results before Tuesday's open at 8am ET — consensus projects $3.29 EPS (up 783% year-over-year) on $5.58B revenue; the stock has rebounded roughly 14% over the past month ahead of the report; investors will focus on revenue per monthly active user and operating income trajectory, with options markets pricing an 8.6% post-earnings move.
    Source: Yahoo Finance / The Cerbat Gem
  • AAPL Declares $0.27 Quarterly Dividend, Ex-Date August 10 — Steadying Signal After Last Week's 8-10% Crash
    Apple declared a quarterly dividend of $0.27 per share (ex-date August 10, payment August 13), the first routine corporate action since last week's 8-10% post-earnings drop on weak guidance — the 10-year dividend growth streak continues as analysts at Citi ($365 target) and TD Cowen ($350) maintain buy ratings and AAPL works to recover the ~$25 gap to the lowest bullish price target.
    Source: MarketBeat / Stock Analysis
  • VTI Enters Historically Weak August-September Window: NFP Jobs Report Friday the Week's Key Macro Catalyst
    Total market ETF holders navigate the week with mixed signals: an 85% earnings-beat rate is supportive, but August-September are historically the market's weakest seasonal months per RBC Capital, which reiterated an 8,150 S&P 500 target; Friday's non-farm payrolls report is the week's macro wildcard — a strong number could revive Fed rate-hike expectations and push NJ's 30-year mortgage rate (currently 7.02%) higher before fall.
    Source: CNBC / RBC Capital

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • National Night Out Montclair Tomorrow: Aug 4, 5-8pm at Lackawanna Station — Police, Fire, Family Fun, Free Admission
    Montclair's National Night Out community event returns to Lackawanna Station this Tuesday August 4 from 5 to 8 p.m., with representatives from the Montclair Police Department, Fire Department, and Ambulance Unit alongside safety demos, giveaways, kid-friendly activities, and local food vendors — a free, no-tickets-needed family evening at the heart of downtown, ideal with a 12-year-old in tow.
    Source: Montclair Local
  • NJ State Fair Monster Trucks Tuesday & Wednesday at 7pm in Augusta — $15 Adults, $10 Kids; Fair Through Aug 8
    The NJ State Fair's Monster Truck Shows (featuring Zombie Sniper, Hurricane Force, and Killer Bee) headline the outdoor arena this Tuesday August 4 and Wednesday August 5 at 7pm at Sussex County Fairgrounds in Augusta NJ (~55 miles from Montclair) — tickets are $15 adults, $10 for kids 6-12, under-5 free; the fair remains open through Saturday August 8 at $5 general adult admission.
    Source: Sussex County Fairgrounds / KSR Motorsports
  • Bloomfield Vintage Book Sale Today at 73 Essex Ave — Antiquarian & Modern Finds a Short Drive From Montclair
    A Vintage, Antiquarian, and Modern Book Sale runs today (August 3, 9am) at 73 Essex Ave in Bloomfield — a 10-minute drive from Montclair and a great browse for sci-fi and fiction fans of all ages; separately, the annual Montclair Used Book, Movie & Music Sale at 26 Park St is currently accepting donations this week before its community sale later in August.
    Source: Montclair Patch

item.title: Daily Briefing — 2026-08-02
item.description: BJJ: CBJJE National Championships Conclude Today: Black Belt Finals Stream Live on FloGrappling, National Champions Crowned. | Soccer: Atletico Fall 2-1 to Man United in Stockholm Pre-Season Opener — Mbeumo Brace Overturns Arnau Ortiz's Fast Start. | Finance: AAPL Buy-the-Dip Consensus Solidifies After 8% Drop: Citi Maintains $365 Target, TD Cowen and Maxim at $350. | NJ Local: NJ State Fair Today: Sold-Out Demolition Derby in Augusta — Monster Trucks Arrive Tuesday-Wednesday Through August 8.
item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • CBJJE National Championships Conclude Today: Black Belt Finals Stream Live on FloGrappling, National Champions Crowned
    The 2026 CBJJE National BJJ Championships wrap up their three-day run today (August 2) at 12pm UTC, crowning black belt national champions across all weight divisions in Brazil's largest federation event of the pre-ADCC summer — streaming live on FloGrappling.
    Source: FloGrappling
  • Tackett Defends Belt 20 Days After UFC BJJ 2 Win — August 20 Card Features Canuto at Lightweight, Women's Flyweight GP
    Andrew Tackett, who retained his welterweight title by D'Arce choke on July 31, defends again at UFC BJJ 10 on August 20 — just 20 days later — against Jonnatas Gracie; Renato Canuto (Tackett's defeated challenger) immediately pivots to a UFC BJJ Lightweight title fight against Ethan Crelinsten, plus the inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix with Adele Fornarino vs. Carol Brunacio.
    Source: UFC
  • 41 Days to ADCC Krakow: With CBJJE Done, No Major Grappling Events Until UFC BJJ 10 on August 20
    With the CBJJE Nationals wrapping today and WNO dark, the competitive grappling calendar enters an 18-day lull until UFC BJJ 10 (August 20) — after which ADCC Krakow's 128-athlete World Championship (September 12-13, Tauron Arena) is just 23 days further, creating a compressed final stretch for elite camps.
    Source: ADCC News

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Atletico Fall 2-1 to Man United in Stockholm Pre-Season Opener — Mbeumo Brace Overturns Arnau Ortiz's Fast Start
    Manchester United beat Atletico Madrid 2-1 in the Snapdragon Cup at Strawberry Arena, Stockholm on August 1: Arnau Ortiz gave Atletico a 5th-minute lead, but Bryan Mbeumo converted a second-half penalty and added a close-range finish to complete the comeback — Atletico's first competitive-style test ahead of the August 16 La Liga opener.
    Source: Sky Sports
  • Alvarez Deal Expected Before La Liga Opener: PSG Framework Agreement in Place, Personal Terms Done, €125M+ Fee Range
    Multiple sources confirm PSG and Atletico Madrid have a working club-to-club framework agreement for Julian Alvarez's transfer with personal terms also done at a fee reportedly in the €125M+ range — the deal is expected before La Liga's August 16-17 opener, marking the end of a months-long saga and leaving Atletico urgently needing a striker replacement.
    Source: Yahoo Sports
  • Atletico Reversal: 'No Plans to Sell Sorloth' Despite Tottenham and Saudi Links — Striker Crisis Looms With 14 Days to La Liga Opener
    After weeks of reporting Sorloth heading to Tottenham, TribalFootball reports Atletico Madrid now have 'no plans to sell' Alexander Sorloth — a striking reversal that leaves the club planning to open La Liga's title defense on August 16 with only Lookman and Sorloth up front once Alvarez departs, despite Saudi interest from Al Hilal.
    Source: TribalFootball

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • AAPL Buy-the-Dip Consensus Solidifies After 8% Drop: Citi Maintains $365 Target, TD Cowen and Maxim at $350
    Following Apple's 8-10% Friday crash on weak guidance, Wall Street is firmly in buy-the-dip mode: Citi ($365), TD Cowen ($350), and Maxim ($350) all maintained or reaffirmed bullish targets, viewing the guidance miss as a transient supply issue rather than a structural problem — the stock needs to recover roughly $25+ from post-earnings levels to reach the lowest upgraded target.
    Source: Yahoo Finance / MarketBeat
  • SPOT Dips 3.46% Friday, Heads Into Tuesday Aug 4 Earnings With 785% YoY EPS Consensus and 8.6% Options Swing
    Spotify stock fell 3.46% on July 31 (caught in Apple-led tech selling) and enters Tuesday's pre-market Q2 earnings with consensus projecting $3.29 EPS (up 785% year-over-year) and $5.6B revenue; options markets are pricing an 8.6% post-earnings move, making Tuesday's report one of the most consequential events this week for growth investors.
    Source: TradingKey / MarketBeat
  • ANCHOR Benefit Confirmation Letters Arriving in August — NJ Homeowners Receive September 15 Direct Deposit Notice (Up to $1,750)
    New Jersey's ANCHOR property tax relief program is sending confirmation letters to eligible homeowners this month, confirming September 15 direct-deposit payments worth up to $1,500 ($1,750 with the senior bonus); homeowners who haven't yet filed the combined PAS-1 form (ANCHOR + Senior Freeze + Stay NJ) should do so immediately as the September deadline approaches.
    Source: NJ Division of Taxation

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • NJ State Fair Today: Sold-Out Demolition Derby in Augusta — Monster Trucks Arrive Tuesday-Wednesday Through August 8
    Today's top NJ event is the Demolition Derby at the NJ State Fair in Augusta, Sussex County (sold out, but fair gates open 10am, $5 adults, kids under 12 free) — Monster Trucks take the arena on Tuesday August 4 and Wednesday August 5, followed by the Championship Pulling Series Thursday and Truck Pull Friday, with the fair running through Saturday August 8.
    Source: Sussex County Fairgrounds
  • First Friday Montclair Returns August 7, 5-9pm at Lackawanna Station — Late Summer Shopping, Dining, Discovery Night
    Lackawanna Station's monthly First Friday event returns this coming Friday August 7 from 5-9pm, with late-night shopping at local boutiques, food, live entertainment, and an outdoor social atmosphere in the heart of downtown Montclair — a great low-key weeknight option ahead of Barknic's August 8 fundraiser.
    Source: Lackawanna Station
  • Final Day: NJ Lottery SpeedTour at NJMP Today — F4 US and Formula Americas Open-Wheel Racing in Millville
    The NJ Lottery SpeedTour's final day at NJ Motorsports Park in Millville, NJ wraps today (Sunday, August 2), with F4 US Championship and Formula Americas open-wheel racing on Thunderbolt Raceway — a 90-minute drive from Montclair and an ideal motorsport outing for families with teens who love speed.
    Source: NJ Motorsports Park

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

    The 2026 CBJJE National BJJ Championships are in their second of three days in Brazil, with adult black belt divisional finals taking center stage; Day 3 (August 2) will crown national champions across all weight categories in the largest gi federation event of the pre-ADCC summer, streaming live on FloGrappling.
    Source: FloGrappling
  • ADCC Krakow 42 Days Out: All 128 Camps Underway, August 24 Final Roster Deadline Confirmed
    With 42 days until ADCC 2026 (Sept 12-13, Tauron Arena Krakow), all 128 grapplers are in intensive pre-tournament camp; ADCC confirmed August 24 as the absolute final deadline for roster adjustments, adding certainty to a $362,000 prize-pool event headlined by the Duarte-Simoes superfight and featuring a full 128-athlete bracket.
    Source: ADCC News
  • Post-WNO Landscape: UFC BJJ 10 Now the Last Major No-Gi Card Before ADCC Krakow
    With Who's Number One on indefinite hiatus and the gi season complete, UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex, free on YouTube) stands as the final high-profile no-gi event before September's ADCC World Championship — the three-title-fight card featuring the inaugural Women's Flyweight Grand Prix is now the grappling community's last competitive tune-up before Krakow.
    Source: Kakutogi

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Atletico vs. Man United Today in Stockholm — Simeone's Full Squad Takes the Field for First Real Test
    Atletico Madrid and Manchester United meet at Strawberry Arena today (3pm CET) in Simeone's most meaningful pre-season fixture: all 13 World Cup returnees are now integrated and summer signings Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Lee Kang-in line up together for the first time in a competitive setting ahead of La Liga's August 16 opener.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official
  • Alvarez PSG Move Nearing Completion: Club Agreement in Place, Personal Terms Done, Deal Expected Before Aug 16
    Multiple sources confirm PSG and Atletico Madrid have a working framework agreement for Julian Alvarez (reportedly around EUR 150M+), with the player's personal terms also agreed; the transfer is now expected to be completed before La Liga's August 16-17 opener, though Atletico maintain Alvarez is training normally and no deal is officially announced.
    Source: TransferFeed / Forbes
  • Atletico Striker Crisis: Alvarez to PSG + Sorloth to Spurs Leaves No. 9 Vacancy Before La Liga Kicks Off
    With Alvarez nearing PSG and Sorloth bound for Tottenham, Atletico face a genuine striker void heading into their La Liga title defense — Lookman is the only natural finisher remaining on the books, and Simeone must secure a replacement before August 16's opener at Espanyol or rely on an improvised attacking structure.
    Source: Into the Calderon

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • AAPL Craters 8-10% at Open — Weak Guidance Wipes $430B in Market Cap Despite Earnings Beat
    Apple shares opened down roughly 8.6% Friday to around $307 — their worst opening move since August 2024 — after Q3 earnings beat on revenue ($109.42B) and EPS ($2.02) but weak forward guidance shocked investors: executives flagged supply constraints and guided only 9-11% revenue growth, below the 11.8% consensus, in what was also Tim Cook's final earnings call as CEO.
    Source: 9to5Mac / 247 Wall St.
  • Amazon +12% as Tech Earnings Diverge; SPOT Rises to $495 With 3 Days to Tuesday August 4 Report
    Big Tech earnings split is sharp today: Amazon surges 12% on its record $200B Q2 while Apple sinks 8-10% on supply-constraint guidance; Spotify (SPOT) gains around 2.5% to $495 ahead of its Tuesday August 4 Q2 report, where analysts project $3.29 EPS (up 783% YoY) and $5.6B revenue — released pre-market Tuesday morning.
    Source: 247 Wall St. / Yahoo Finance

    Source: Stock Market Watch

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • Watershed Butterfly Festival Today in Pennington — Live Butterflies, Insect Parade, Science Exhibits
    The Watershed Institute's Butterfly Festival runs today (August 1, 9:30am-3pm) at 31 Titus Mill Road, Pennington NJ (about 30 min from Montclair), with guided butterfly-house tours, a butterfly and insect parade, hands-on animal exhibits, and science activities — $10/person or $30/carload up to six, a perfect mid-day family outing.
    Source: NJ Is Not Boring
  • Warren County Balloon Festival Closing Day Today + Highlands Clam Fest Fireworks at 10pm Tonight
    Today is the last day of the Warren County Farmers' Fair and Hot Air Balloon Festival (Harmony Township, about 1hr from Montclair, $10 adults, $5 kids 6-12) with a dusk balloon launch tonight; the 31st Annual Highlands Clam Fest at the Shore also wraps up with live music, a beer garden, food trucks, and a 10pm fireworks display over Snug Harbor Beach.
    Source: Balloon Fest NJ
  • Montclair August Calendar: Jazz Soundcheck Aug 4, Barknic Fundraiser Aug 8, Vintage Market Aug 15
    Three upcoming Montclair-area events: the free Montclair Jazz Festival Soundcheck Series continues at Lackawanna Station this Tuesday August 4 evening; Barknic (Saturday August 8) is a dog-friendly outdoor fundraiser for Wise Animal Rescue with vendors and family activities; and a vintage fair featuring retro clothing, vinyl records, antiques, and furniture comes to downtown Montclair on Saturday August 15.
    Source: Montclair Girl

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • CBJJE National BJJ Championships Underway July 31–August 2 on FloGrappling
    The 2026 CBJJE National BJJ Championships kicked off today and run through August 2, streaming on FloGrappling — the largest gi event broadcast this week and a major title-pathway event for Brazilian federation athletes.
    Source: FloGrappling
  • UFC BJJ 10 Full Card: Three Title Fights August 20 — Tackett vs. Gracie Headlines
    UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex, free on YouTube) features three title bouts: Andrew Tackett defends the Welterweight belt against Jonnatas Gracie, Ethan Crelinsten meets Renato Canuto for the Lightweight title, and Brianna Ste-Marie debuts against Women's Featherweight champion Rebeca Lima — alongside the Women's Flyweight GP semifinal.
    Source: UFC
  • WNO Effectively Goes Dark — FloGrappling GM Confirms Top Grapplers Have Moved On
    FloGrappling GM Ben Kovacs confirmed that Who's Number One has gone on an indefinite hiatus, citing top competitors migrating to UFC BJJ and ONE Championship for better pay and exposure — a significant shift in the no-gi landscape just weeks before ADCC Krakow.
    Source: BJJ Eastern Europe

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Álvarez Transfer Climax: Barcelona Deadline Expires, Player Reportedly Agrees PSG Terms
    Barcelona's self-imposed July 31 signing deadline passed without a deal — Atletico's CEO rejected all offers up to €200M — while FourFourTwo reports Álvarez has now agreed personal terms with PSG after the French club's ~€130M offer, a dramatic shift from his earlier preference for Barcelona.
    Source: FourFourTwo / Goal.com
  • Sørloth–Juventus Deal Collapses; Tottenham Emerge as New Frontrunners
    The long-stalled Alexander Sørloth transfer to Juventus has officially fallen apart after the clubs failed to bridge a €10M+ fee gap — Atletico held at €40M, Juventus refused to exceed €30M; Tottenham have now entered the race and are reportedly the new frontrunners for the Norwegian striker.
    Source: Sporten
  • Ter Stegen Joins Ajax on Loan as Barcelona Clears Wages for Álvarez Push
    Barcelona have agreed to send goalkeeper Marc-André ter Stegen to Ajax on loan, freeing significant wages — part of a broader financial restructuring alongside a €210M TV rights advance that signals the club's all-in commitment to signing Julián Álvarez from Atletico Madrid.
    Source: BeSoccer

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Apple Q3: Revenue Beat but Services and China Miss — Stock Down 3–4% After Hours in Cook's Final Call
    Apple posted $109.42B in Q3 revenue (+16% YoY) and EPS of $2.02, both beating consensus, but services revenue of $30.74B missed the $31.22B target and China sales of $18.8B fell short — sending shares down 3–4% after hours in Tim Cook's farewell earnings call before John Ternus takes over as CEO.
    Source: Quartz
  • Amazon Posts First-Ever $200B Quarter — AWS Grows 37%, EPS More Than Doubles, Stock Surges
    Amazon's Q2 was a clean sweep: $200.61B revenue (+19.6% YoY), EPS of $5.75 more than doubling estimates, and AWS growing 36.8% to $42.23B — its fastest pace since 2021; a $53.4B pre-tax gain from the Anthropic stake pushed net income to $62.65B, sending the stock sharply higher after hours.
    Source: Yahoo Finance
  • Markets Stage Broad Recovery July 31 — S&P +1.7%, MSFT +16%, Nasdaq +2.8%; SPOT Up 10.5% Pre-Earnings
    Stocks rebounded sharply Thursday: S&P 500 +1.66%, Dow +614 points, Nasdaq +2.8% — led by Microsoft's record +16% single-session gain on Azure's blowout results; Spotify (SPOT) added 10.5% over its pre-earnings week with 4 days to its August 4 Q2 report, where options now imply an 8.6% swing.
    Source: Bloomberg

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • MM by Morimoto's Opening Night: Early Reviews Praise Wagyu and Sushi, Flag $300 Omakase Value
    Now open at 193 Glenridge Ave, Iron Chef Morimoto's Montclair debut is drawing early Yelp and TripAdvisor reviews praising the wagyu and high-end sushi while flagging the 10-course $300 omakase as a tough value proposition — the ambitious restaurant featuring imported Japanese fish, A5 Wagyu, and an omakase bar may need a few weeks to fully gel.
    Source: Yelp / TripAdvisor
  • Montclair Farmers Market Opens August 1 at Walnut Street Station — 8am–2pm Every Saturday Through November
    The weekly Montclair Farmers' Market runs at 86 Walnut Street (Walnut Street Station) through November every Saturday 8am–2pm, with fresh produce, meats, fish, cheese, baked goods, flowers, and local vendors — a relaxed Saturday morning option before heading to the Warren County Balloon Festival or NJ State Fair.
    Source: Experience Montclair
  • Free Essex County Concert: Xtreme Queen Tribute at Brookdale Park August 7 at 7:30pm
    Essex County's free 2026 Summer Music Concert Series brings Xtreme Queen (Queen tribute band) to Brookdale Park on the Bloomfield/Montclair border on Friday August 7 at 7:30 PM — no tickets, all ages, and a great family evening option leading into the Montclair Jazz Festival weekend (August 15).
    Source: Patch / Essex County Parks

item.content:encoded:
Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • UFC BJJ 2 Results: Tackett Retains With D'Arce Choke, Fowler Wins Inaugural LHW Title — All First-Round Finishes
    Andrew Tackett retained his welterweight belt by submitting Renato Canuto with a D'Arce choke in round one, while Mason Fowler captured the inaugural UFC BJJ light heavyweight title via rear-naked choke over David Garmo — making it a first-round finish double-header on the free YouTube card from UFC Apex. The undercard also went all submissions, including debut wins for William Tackett and Raquel Canuto.
    Source: UFC
  • ADCC 2026 in Crisis: Only ~4 Tickets/Day Sold for 15,000-Seat Krakow Venue With 6 Weeks to Go
    With approximately six weeks until the September 12-13 World Championship, ADCC 2026 is reportedly selling only about four tickets per day at Tauron Arena Kraków — a 15,030-seat venue — compounding a rough summer that includes Gordon Ryan's retirement, Nicholas Meregali in doubt with a shoulder injury, the Michell removal controversy, and ADCC quietly deleting its own invite list from its website.
    Source: BJJ World
  • BJJ Stars 19 Tonight in São Paulo: R$200K Masters Absolute, Moicano vs. Pitbull Superfight
    BJJ Stars 19 streams live from Vibra São Paulo tonight at 7:40pm ET, headlined by a 16-man Masters absolute bracket with a R$200,000 prize for the champion; UFC lightweight contender Renato Moicano faces Patricky Pitbull in the marquee superfight alongside five additional grappling bouts.
    Source: FloGrappling

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • Lookman Debut Brace Leads Atletico 4-1 Over Getafe in Pre-Season Opener
    Atletico Madrid opened their 2026-27 pre-season with a 4-1 win over Getafe at Majadahonda, with new signing Ademola Lookman stealing the show with two first-half goals (5', 35'). Arnau Ortiz and Obed Vargas added second-half goals, and crucially both José María Giménez (ankle) and Johnny Cardoso (post-surgery) featured for the first time this season, giving Simeone encouraging fitness news ahead of Saturday's Stockholm friendly.
    Source: Into the Calderon
  • Nico González Confirmed Permanent at Atletico — ~€36M Deal Agreed With Juventus
    Atletico Madrid have confirmed the permanent signing of Nico González from Juventus for approximately €36M after his 2025-26 loan, after the original €32M buy-option clause was not triggered when the Argentine winger failed to reach the 60%-of-matches appearance threshold. With Nico now officially a permanent Atletico player rather than a swap chip, the Sorloth-to-Juventus negotiation must find a new path to close.
    Source: Goal.com
  • PSG Submit Formal Álvarez Bid; Atletico CEO Threatens FIFA Complaint Against Barcelona
    The Julián Álvarez transfer saga escalated sharply: PSG submitted a formal offer for the Argentine striker, while Atletico's CEO publicly threatened a FIFA complaint against Barcelona over alleged illegal contact with the player. No deal is done — Atletico remain firm on their valuation — but the transfer is now in an active, confrontational phase that could force resolution before La Liga opens August 16.
    Source: ESPN

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Meta EPS Misses by 14%, Stock -10% AH; Microsoft Beats Cleanly — Divergent Big Tech Earnings
    Two starkly different Big Tech nights: Meta Q2 revenue hit $60.8B (beat) but EPS of $6.18 badly missed the $7.17 consensus as expenses surged 55% YoY on AI infrastructure, sending the stock down ~10% after hours; meanwhile Microsoft posted record Q4 revenue of $90.0B (+18%) with EPS of $4.74 (12% beat) and Azure growing 27% YoY — though its guided $255-260B FY2027 capex continues to weigh on the AI spending narrative.
    Source: Shacknews / 247 Wall St.
  • Apple Reports Q3 Tonight — Tim Cook's Final Earnings Call; $108.9B Revenue Consensus, $5T Market Cap on the Line
    Apple releases Q3 FY2026 results after tonight's close in Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus takes the CEO role; consensus targets $108.9B revenue (+16% YoY) and $1.89 EPS (+20%), with Apple entering the print at ~$338 after recently crossing the $5 trillion market-cap milestone. Analysts will scrutinize services growth, AI capital spending, and early iPhone 18 pricing signals.
    Source: CNBC
  • Mag 7 Falls 4.8%, Dow -1,153 Points on AI Capex Fears; NJ Mortgage Rate Holds at 7.02%
    Big Tech's AI spending blowout rattled the broader market on July 29-30: the Magnificent Seven fell 4.8% (worst day since April 2025), the Dow sank 1,153 points (-2.19%), and the S&P 500 dropped 1.52% as investors question the return on massive capex commitments. NJ homeowners see no relief — the 30-year fixed mortgage rate holds at 7.02%, with the Fed's fifth consecutive hold at 3.5-3.75% having no meaningful effect on rates tethered to bond market yields.
    Source: Fortune / MortgageNewsDaily

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • MM by Morimoto Opens Tomorrow (July 31) — Full Hours Confirmed, Resy Reservations Live
    Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's 12,779-sq-ft Montclair restaurant opens Thursday July 31 at 193 Glenridge Ave with dinner from 5pm nightly (Fri-Sat until midnight); the menu features imported Japanese fish, A5 Wagyu, a custom omakase bar, and USDA Prime steaks — book tonight on Resy as opening-week tables are filling fast.
    Source: MM by Morimoto
  • Spider-Man: Brand New Day Opens July 31 — MCU Return of Tom Holland, Perfect for the 12-Year-Old
    Tom Holland returns as an adult Peter Parker in the latest MCU Spider-Man film opening July 31 in theaters nationwide; directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, Peter has erased himself from the memories of everyone he loves and must face a villain only he can see — advance tickets on sale now at AMC and Cinemark locations throughout NJ.
    Source: Marvel / Fandango
  • NJ State Fair Opens Tomorrow Through August 8 — $5 Adults, Kids Under 12 Free, Augusta NJ
    The New Jersey State Fair / Sussex County Farm & Horse Show kicks off July 31 through August 8 at the Sussex County Fairgrounds in Augusta, NJ (~55 miles from Montclair), with $5 adult admission and free entry for children 12 and under; highlights include monster trucks, demolition derbies, a horse show, carnival rides, and agricultural exhibits.
    Source: Sussex County Fairgrounds

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling

  • UFC BJJ 2 Two Days Out: Weigh-Ins Tomorrow Morning, Ceremonial Faceoffs Stream Live Wednesday Evening
    Official weigh-ins for UFC BJJ 2 take place Wednesday morning (July 30) at the UFC Apex, with ceremonial faceoffs streaming live Wednesday evening on UFC YouTube; all 10 bouts are confirmed — Andrew Tackett defends the welterweight title against Renato Canuto in the main event, Mason Fowler vs. David Garmo crowns the inaugural light heavyweight champion in the co-main, and a family subplot sees Tackett's brother and Canuto's wife both debuting on the undercard.
    Source: UFC
  • ADCC Krakow 44 Days Out: Elite Camps Deep in Session; Galvao's Reinstatement Makes 77kg the Division to Watch
    With 44 days until ADCC 2026 (September 12-13, Tauron Arena Krakow), top grapplers including Kaynan Duarte, Yuri Simoes, and the reinstated Mica Galvao are in intensive training camp; Galvao's return reshapes an already stacked 77kg bracket, making it arguably the most anticipated division at the $362,000 prize-pool world championship alongside the Duarte-Simoes absolute superfight.
    Source: FloGrappling
  • UFC BJJ 10 Women's Flyweight Grand Prix August 20: Fornarino vs. Brunacio Headline Inaugural Bracket
    With UFC BJJ 2 days away, eyes are already turning to UFC BJJ 10 (August 20, Meta Apex): ADCC double-champion Adele Fornarino — who chose this event over ADCC Krakow — faces Brazilian standout Carol Brunacio in the semifinals of the first-ever UFC BJJ Women's Flyweight Grand Prix, a four-woman bracket that will crown the series' inaugural women's flyweight champion.
    Source: Jits Magazine

Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)

  • PSG Preparing €164M Formal Offer for Alvarez as Atletico-PSG Transfer Alignment Hardens
    Multiple transfer sources report PSG is finalizing a formal €164M bid for Julian Alvarez, with Atletico Madrid steering the deal toward Paris rather than Barcelona; Spanish analyst Martin Otin claims Alvarez has already decided on PSG, while the player himself publicly refuses to rule out a future move — the formal offer's arrival could force a resolution before La Liga opens August 16.
    Source: Yahoo Sports
  • Atletico vs. Manchester United Saturday in Stockholm — Full Squad Ready for Simeone's First Complete Pre-Season Test
    Three days from Atletico Madrid's August 1 Stockholm friendly at Strawberry Arena (3pm CET), Diego Simeone has his complete squad at Majadahonda for the first time — all World Cup returnees integrated alongside summer signings Grimaldo, Hjulmand, and Kang-in — making this the most important training week of the pre-season ahead of the La Liga title-defense opener away at Espanyol on August 16.
    Source: Atletico Madrid Official
  • Sorloth-Juventus: Nico Gonzalez Swap Tabled as Clubs Attempt to Bridge the Fee Gap
    Into the Calderon reports Juventus have proposed including midfielder Nico Gonzalez in a player-plus-cash arrangement to bridge Atletico's €35-40M asking price and Juventus's reluctance to exceed €30M fixed; with personal terms long since agreed between Sorloth and Juventus, the Gonzalez swap is the latest attempt to unlock a deal stalled for weeks.
    Source: Into the Calderon

Financial Freedom & Markets

  • Fed Holds at 3.5-3.75% — Warsh Signals Inflation Vigilance at Press Conference, September Hike Odds Rise
    The FOMC voted to hold the federal funds rate at 3.5-3.75% today (July 29), the fifth consecutive hold; Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced his hawkish stance at the 2:30pm ET press conference with zero tolerance rhetoric for persistent inflation — markets responded by pushing September hike probability higher, a headwind for NJ homeowners hoping for mortgage rate relief before fall.
    Source: France24
  • Meta and Microsoft Report Tonight After Close — $60B META Quarter, Azure Growth, AI Capex Scale in Focus
    Meta Platforms ($7.21 EPS, $60.22B revenue consensus, +27% YoY) and Microsoft ($4.22 EPS, $87.5B revenue, Azure 40-42% growth expected) both report Q2/Q4 FY2026 results after today's close; investors are focused on $125-145B in Meta capex commitments and Copilot commercialization at Microsoft — paired beats or misses will directly set sentiment for Apple's report tomorrow and Spotify's August 4 call.
    Source: TipRanks
  • AAPL Earnings Tomorrow: Cook's Final Call as CEO, $1.89 EPS Consensus, iPhone 18 Pricing Signals Expected
    Apple reports Q3 FY2026 earnings after tomorrow's close (5pm ET) in Tim Cook's final earnings call before John Ternus takes over as CEO; consensus projects $1.89 EPS on $108.8-110B revenue (+14-17% YoY), with key focus on services growth, AI narrative, and iPhone 18 Pro pricing — analysts suggest a ~$270 premium over the iPhone 17 Pro may be needed to sustain ~47% gross margins amid a global chip shortage.
    Source: Yahoo Finance

NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)

  • Warren County Farmers' Fair & Hot Air Balloon Festival This Weekend — Dusk Balloon Launches Aug 1-2
    The 2026 Warren County Farmers' Fair & Hot Air Balloon Festival runs August 1-2 at the Warren County Fairgrounds in Harmony Township (~1 hour from Montclair), featuring agricultural exhibits, carnival rides, live music, local food, and the signature event: hot air balloon launches at dusk Saturday and Sunday — one of NJ's most distinctive summer family traditions.
    Source: NJ Family
  • MM by Morimoto Opens TOMORROW (July 31) in Montclair — Tonight Is Last Chance to Book on Resy
    Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's eagerly awaited MM by Morimoto opens its doors tomorrow (Thursday, July 31) at 193 Glenridge Ave, Montclair, with exclusive fish from Japan, A5 Wagyu beef, and a custom omakase bar — book tonight on Resy to lock in opening-week tables before they're gone; Pig & Butter (401 Orange Rd) also opens tomorrow with its ribbon-cutting at 10am.
    Source: Montclair Girl
  • Six Flags Great Adventure Boardwalk Nights: Final Weekend Aug 1-2 — Extended Hours, Full Thrills
    This weekend (August 1-2) is the last Boardwalk Nights event at Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson, NJ (~50 minutes from Montclair), with extended park hours, special entertainment, and full access to all rides — a strong option for families with a 12-year-old looking for a high-energy late-summer outing before the series wraps for 2026.
    Source: NJ Family
